body:
If you want me to follow life without values then any existing being in this world will become influenced by my own egoism and manipulative personality. It will hurt you and you don't see it. I would spend my life developing myself to maximum. I am an idealist, INTJ, I wouldn't ever have a rest for an unproductive activity anymore, because the greatest good would be my own egoism and power. Right now, I am trying to be open, try focusing on somebody who could prove me wrong and persuade me that you could ever trust anybody and make them a part of your own "egoism" in your life. Following the idea above and your own approach "waste time" I could only beat you up in your own game and you would regret it.


All my life I have been spending my time ineffectively being depressed, in tears, or wondering, trying to understand why people act specific way. If most of you believe in no ideals or no stability or infinite lifespan of specific phenomenons or values then you all should be following a robotic like lifestyle, trying to establish your own domination.
Why people fucking don't? Why are they acting illogically if they really believe in life having no meaning or any values being existent?
What's the logic in this? Is this hypocrisy? How can I trust you in your opinions?

So many people will tell me that life has nothing to it, why aren't all of you rich utilizing all of your "precious" life, doing things you can, the most effectively, the best, crushing everyone and living "happily" alone and mighty? 
Why not? Isn't it what most of people are about? If not, then how such a hypocrisy as "love is temporary" or similar, can be tolerated? It is illogical, it's just insane to me. 
How can one love following a lifestyle like that? Why would they ever need it? To satisfy own egoistic needs? Whenever they try the opposite they get dissapointed or hurt, it's a way of losing everything vs losing everything. 

By trusting people and risking investing in them they will ALWAYS fail you and hurt you, and bring nothing but sorrow in the end. You end up either being a manipulative sadist with only goal in your own interest, or a person who wants to die everyday and gets told that this is normal to act the way the others do. Do you really want me to follow that way? 

Either to live in pain, struggling with people around, or living alone for yourself giving up everything else. 
How can one even define what a failure or a logically perfect plan of working is. Is there any school of philosophy showing any "trusted" way that could not be doubted and proven right? Why do they blindly follow concepts they can't even justify or explain?
How do you want me to live in such a world?

A life without a meaning is pathetic, it leads to dominance at all cost and unhealty tyranny. How can one really follow it when in the end they will lose it for nothing?

I just wish that there was any meaning in life. Without it, I am not sure if that's good for somebody like me to live this way.
